**Direct answer:** The question rests on a false premise. Einstein never won a Nobel Prize for general relativity. He won the 1921 Nobel Prize in Physics, which was formally awarded in 1922. The citation names his services to theoretical physics and the law of the photoelectric effect.

Claims and sources:

- The prize citation reads "for his services to Theoretical Physics, and especially for his discovery of the law of the photoelectric effect." It does not mention relativity.
  - https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1921/einstein/facts/ (appeared in search results; my direct fetch of the page returned 403, so I relied on the search summary)
  - https://nobel-prize.net/en/topics/einstein-and-the-prize/

- The 1921 prize was reserved. On 9 November 1922 the Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences voted to give it to Einstein.
  - https://arxiv.org/pdf/2112.13519
  - https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/andp.202200305

- Relativity was avoided in the award, reportedly because some committee members found it controversial. The search summary also said the notification telegram explicitly said relativity was not considered. I did not open these pages myself, so treat the telegram detail as less certain.
  - https://arxiv.org/pdf/2112.13519
  - https://arxiv.org/pdf/1807.02134

- Historians dispute parts of the usual story. A 2022 *Annalen der Physik* article argues that the "photoelectric effect" framing and the claim that a committee member's misunderstanding of relativity blocked it are oversimplified.
  - https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/andp.202200305

- Einstein's Nobel lecture was nonetheless about relativity. This comes from the search summary only, and I did not verify it on a primary page.

Two limits on this research: the nobelprize.org pages were blocked when I fetched them directly, and I made no further fetches. The claims above come from search-result summaries, not full-page reads.

Sources:
- [Albert Einstein – Nobel Prize facts](https://www.nobelprize.org/prizes/physics/1921/einstein/facts/)
- [Einstein and the Prize](https://nobel-prize.net/en/topics/einstein-and-the-prize/)
- [The incredibly strange story of Einstein's Nobel prize (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/2112.13519)
- [The 100th Anniversary of Einstein's Nobel Prize: Facts and Fiction (Annalen der Physik)](https://onlinelibrary.wiley.com/doi/10.1002/andp.202200305)
- [The Impact Of World War I On Relativity: Part III (arXiv)](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1807.02134)
